lines.translation: Abandon slander and envy of others.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਦਝਹਿ ਸਾਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: paR paR dajhahi saat na aaee ||
lines.translation: Reading and studying, they burn, and do not find tranquility.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਹੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: mil satasa(n)gat naam salaahahu aatam raam sakhaaee he ||7||
lines.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The Lord, the Supreme Soul, shall be your helper and companion. ||7||
Abandon sexual desire, anger and wickedness.
Abandon your involvement in egotistical affairs and conflicts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਤਾ ਉਬਰਹੁ ਇਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: satigur saran parahu taa ubarahu iu tareeai bhavajal bhaaee he ||8||
lines.translation: If you seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru, then you shall be saved. In this way you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, O Siblings of Destiny. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਬਿਮਲ ਨਦੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਝੇਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aagai bimal nadee agan bikh jhelaa ||
lines.translation: In the hereafter, you shall have to cross over the fiery river of poisonous flames.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਉ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tithai avar na koee jeeu ikelaa ||
lines.translation: No one else will be there; your soul shall be all alone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੜ ਭੜ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੇ ਲਹਰੀ ਪੜਿ ਦਝਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: bhaR bhaR agan saagar de laharee paR dajhahi manamukh taaee he ||9||
lines.translation: The ocean of fire spits out waves of searing flames; the self-willed manmukhs fall into it, and are roasted there. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇ ਭਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur pahi mukat daan de bhaanai ||
lines.translation: Liberation comes from the Guru; He grants this blessing by the Pleasure of His Will.
He alone knows the way, who obtains it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: jin paaiaa tin poochhahu bhaaee sukh satigur sev kamaaee he ||10||
lines.translation: So ask one who has obtained it, O Siblings of Destiny. Serve the True Guru, and find peace. ||10||
Without the Guru, he dies entangled in sin and corruption.
The Messenger of Death smashes his head and humiliates him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਧੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਡੂਬਹਿ ਨਿੰਦ ਪਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: baadhe mukat naahee nar ni(n)dak doobahi ni(n)d paraaee he ||11||
lines.translation: The slanderous person is not freed of his bonds; he is drowned, slandering others. ||11||
So speak the Truth, and realize the Lord deep within.
He is not far away; look, and see Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ਇਉ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: bighan naahee guramukh tar taaree iu bhavajal paar la(n)ghaaee he ||12||
lines.translation: No obstacles shall block your way; become Gurmukh, and cross over to the other side. This is the way to cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||12||
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the body.
The Creator Lord is eternal and imperishable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਜਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: naa jeeu marai na maariaa jaaee kar dekhai sabad rajaaee he ||13||
lines.translation: The soul does not die, and it cannot be killed; God creates and watches over all. Through the Word of the Shabad, His Will is manifest. ||13||
He is immaculate, and has no darkness.
The True Lord Himself sits upon His throne.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜੇ ਬੰਧਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਆਈ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: saakat kooRe ba(n)dh bhavaaeeahi mar janamahi aaee jaaee he ||14||
lines.translation: The faithless cynics are bound and gagged, and forced to wander in reincarnation. They die, and are reborn, and continue coming and going. ||14||
The Guru's servants are the Beloveds of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਤਖਤਿ ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi baisahi takhat s sabad veechaare ||
lines.translation: Contemplating the Shabad, they sit upon His throne.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਲਹਹਿ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: tat lahahi a(n)taragat jaanahi satasa(n)gat saach vadaaee he ||15||
lines.translation: They realize the essence of reality, and know the state of their inner being. This is the true glorious greatness of those who join the Sat Sangat. ||15||
He Himself saves His humble servant, and saves his ancestors as well.
His companions are liberated; He carries them across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਲਾਲਾ ਗੋਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tis kaa laalaa golaa jin guramukh har liv laaee he ||16||6||
lines.translation: Nanak is the servant and slave of that Gurmukh who lovingly focuses his consciousness on the Lord. ||16||6||
Maaroo, First Mehl:
For many ages, only darkness prevailed;
the infinite, endless Lord was absorbed in the primal void.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dhu(n)dhookaar niraalam baithaa naa tad dha(n)dh pasaaraa he ||1||
lines.translation: He sat alone and unaffected in absolute darkness; the world of conflict did not exist. ||1||
Thirty-six ages passed like this.
He causes all to happen by the Pleasure of His Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਈ ਆਪੇ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tisahi sareek na deesai koee aape apar apaaraa he ||2||
lines.translation: No rival of His can be seen. He Himself is infinite and endless. ||2||
God is hidden throughout the four ages - understand this well.
He pervades each and every heart, and is contained within the belly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕਾ ਏਕੀ ਵਰਤੈ ਕੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jug jug ekaa ekee varatai koee boojhai gur veechaaraa he ||3||
lines.translation: The One and Only Lord prevails throughout the ages. How rare are those who contemplate the Guru, and understand this. ||3||
From the union of the sperm and the egg, the body was formed.
From the union of air, water and fire, the living being is made.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਚੋਜ ਕਰੇ ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲੀ ਹੋਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: aape choj kare ra(n)g mahalee hor maaiaa moh pasaaraa he ||4||
lines.translation: He Himself plays joyfully in the mansion of the body; all the rest is just attachment to Maya's expanse. ||4||
Within the mother's womb, upside-down, the mortal meditated on God.
The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਦਰ ਮਝਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: saas saas sach naam samaale a(n)tar udar majhaaraa he ||5||
lines.translation: With each and every breath, he contemplated the True Name, deep within himself, within the womb. ||5||
